title: Fan-speed control and cooling-water arrangements in a high-temperature bogie-hearth furnace
summary: Circulation-fan speed and support-frame cooling serve different objects. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s steel-part bogie-hearth proposal dated 21 March 2024 lists two high-temperature axial fans with water-cooled frames, using variable-speed operation: faster at low temperature and slower at high temperature. Confirm temperature-dependent speed and cooling-water circuits separately. Two fans alone do not establish complete high-temperature operating conditions.
